pr_title: Use HTTP/2 for the devserver when using HTTPS
pr_body: # ↪️ Pull Request We're currently using http/1.1 in the devserver when using https which is fine but a lot slower than http/2. This PR changes it to using http/2 so we have an even faster dev experience. Only enabled it on https as HTTP/2 requires a certificate unfortunately and it's probably not a good experience if the first thing people see is a security warning. Falls back to HTTP/1.1 for the hmr websocket, (very) old browsers, out integration tests and scripts that don't use http/2 Closes #4513 ## 💻 Examples `h2` in the network tab means `http/2` ## ✔️ PR Todo - [x] Added/updated unit tests for this change - [x] Filled out test instructions (In case there aren't any unit tests) - [x] Included links to related issues/PRs

I believe this breaks API Proxy when using HTTPS from a browser like Chrome. Because the browser prefers HTTP/2 over 1.1 and it automatically uses that. But the API proxy uses `connect` under the hood which does not like header names like `:path` and `:authority`. Everything works fine on circa nightly.230 and earlier.

issue_context.title: Option for http2 protocol
issue_context.body:
# 🙋 feature request

Option for http2 protocol 

## 🤔 Expected Behavior

change http/1.1 to h2 for fetch bundled resourses from server. 

## 😯 Current Behavior

No way to change protocol for fetch

## 💁 Possible Solution

CLI option which change protocols 

## 🔦 Context

<!--- How has this issue affected you? What are you trying to accomplish? -->
I have a lot of lazy load modules and http/1.1 increases delay for response
comments:
I'd actually want it to be the default but I'm worried about us enforcing encryption by default as we use a self-signed certificate unless one's provided and that will give warnings on most computers. Unless they specifically configured localhost self-signed warnings to be ignored...

~There's also the issue of us now using the same server for the hmr-websocket and file serving. Websockets don't support http/2 so we'd have to hack around that as well... or move it back to 2 different ports~

Apparently ws works fine when allowing http/1.1 as a fallback, opened a PR for this change which only runs http/2 when using the flag `--https` as I don't think we should enable that by default for reasons mentioned above. Should speed up the devserver quite a bit :)

review_comments: I assume we don't need to install or configure anything for this and that it'll just happen to come with Flow some day?
